core_meaning.primary_meaning: Rafayet is an Arabic-origin name meaning “Elevation, dignity”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Arabic word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Rafayet corresponds to the Arabic form رِفْعَة (Arabic root ر ف ع (r-f-ʿ); رِفْعَة (Rifʿa)). Its core sense is rafayet; elevation, dignity. Rafayet is a spelling variant of Arabic رِفْعَة (Rifʿa) 'elevation, dignity', from the root ر ف ع (r-f-ʿ). CRITICAL SOURCE ERROR: the source gave أحمد (a different name); the correct form is رِفْعَة. The source gloss 'Rain Giver' is unsupported and has been replaced with the lexical sense. Same name as rafaat.
